notes.title: V1.02 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a major bug with the keypad that if the player pauses the cursor would disappear 

- Fixed more particle issues

- Fixed the key in the light switch puzzle being really difficult to grab, should be really easy to get now

notes.title: V1.01 Patch!
notes.notes:
First of all thank you all so much for playing the game and giving feedback, it means a lot to me :)

- Fixed a number of small issues that were found on release

- Added Widescreen support (There was an issue with the main menu on widescreen displays, this should hopefully be fixed now

- Fixed some particle issues that were happening in certain loops
